questions.title: NextStep stores data of Resource Persons in a binary file RESOURCES.DAT with record structure: (R_ID, R_Name,
questions.extractedText:
import pickle
import os

def Append():
    f = open('RESOURCES.DAT', 'ab')
    rid = int(input('Enter ID: '))
    name = input('Enter Name: ')
    exp = input('Enter Expertise: ')
    charges = float(input('Enter Charges: '))
    rec = (rid, name, exp, charges)
    pickle.dump(rec, f)
    f.close()

def Update():
    f = open('RESOURCES.DAT', 'rb+')
    try:
        while True:
            pos = f.tell()
            rec = pickle.load(f)
            updated_rec = (rec[0], rec[1], rec[2], rec[3] + 500)
            f.seek(pos)
            pickle.dump(updated_rec, f)
    except EOFError:
        pass
    finally:
        f.close()

questions.title: NextStep stores data of Resource Persons in a binary file RESOURCES.DAT with record structure: (R_ID, R_Name,
questions.extractedText:
import pickle
import os

def Append():
    f = open('RESOURCES.DAT', 'ab')
    rid = int(input('Enter ID: '))
    name = input('Enter Name: ')
    exp = input('Enter Expertise: ')
    charges = float(input('Enter Charges: '))
    rec = (rid, name, exp, charges)
    pickle.dump(rec, f)
    f.close()

def Update():
    f = open('RESOURCES.DAT', 'rb+')
    try:
        while True:
            pos = f.tell()
            rec = pickle.load(f)
            updated_rec = (rec[0], rec[1], rec[2], rec[3] + 500)
            f.seek(pos)
            pickle.dump(updated_rec, f)
    except EOFError:
        pass
    finally:
        f.close()
